unlisted_rule_quote.quote: No use shall be allowed in any district which is not permitted by the regulations for the district.

table_key.quote: BLANK - Use not allowed as listed in the zoning district represented by that column.

unlisted_rule_quote.quote: If the Zoning Administrator determines that an unlisted proposed use does not fall within the definition of a use identified and defined in the Zoning Ordinance, the use is not permitted unless the Board of Supervisors, in its discretion, approves a Zoning Ordinance Amendment (Section 10.10.02) to allow such use.

table_key.quote: A “P” indicates that a specific Use is permitted in the zoning district
An “S” indicates that a Use may be allowed in the zoning district as a Special Exception
An “M” indicates that a Use may be permitted in the zoning district as a Minor Special Exception
A blank cell indicates that the use is not permitted in the district.
